metadata.title: UNSEEN JHARKHANDI Food Series -A New Experience exploring the Incredible Food & Culture of Jharkhand
metadata.description:
Like all other states, Jharkhand too has some intriguing staple traditional food and quintessential street food gems. The foodscape here is as exquisite and vibrant as the abundant natural wonders, mostly because of the different cooking styles and the use of native ingredients. In the upcoming series, we will introduce you to some wondrous flavours from the cities of Ranchi, Jharkhand and Dhanbad and also the stories behind them. Jharkhand food series begins from 02.10.2021. Hop in for a mouth watering ride.

About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://www.instagram.com/anubhav.sapra/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 


Filmed & Designed by Shivam IG : https://www.instagram.com/delhiite_shivamkr/
Text by Swetaleena Nayak
